description: Ownership, intent, review, and lifecycle triggers layered over checks/platform-matrix.json and checks/release-modules.json. Technical route/module facts stay in those catalogs.

releaseCoupling.evidence: checks/release-modules.json, exact workspace pins, and node scripts/validate-release-module-closures.mjs

routes.reviewTrigger: Presenter, evidence manifest, release gate, or product-class change; quarterly otherwise.
routes.graduation: Already committed; retain only while the evidence file records the required runtime L3 and the route remains release-blocking.
routes.retirement: Demote or remove if matching-host evidence cannot be reproduced or an approved successor route replaces it.

routes.reviewTrigger: R6 capability, evidence manifest, release gate, or product-class change; quarterly otherwise.
routes.graduation: Reached `committed` on 2026-11-08 (ADR 0066): matching-emulator L3 covers pixels, pointer, resize, IME text + named keys, clipboard write/read, accessibility node publishing, detach/recreate, viewport, and async image. Re-promotion beyond committed only by a new route/product ADR after a GPU-direct presenter claim with the seven-gate manifests.
routes.retirement: Downgrade by a new ADR if matching-emulator R6 evidence lapses or the window-hosted composition cannot build for two reviews.

routes.reviewTrigger: R6 capability, evidence manifest, release gate, or product-class change; quarterly otherwise.
routes.graduation: Reached `committed` on 2026-11-08 (ADR 0067): matching-simulator evidence covers every R6 capability — pixels, input (pointer + IME text + named keys), detach/recreate, IME, clipboard write/read, accessibility node publishing, async image. Device rotation was not captured live (host automation limitation, recorded in the manifest); a matching-device pass may add it. Promotion beyond committed requires a GPU-direct presenter claim with the seven-gate manifests, via a new ADR.
routes.retirement: Downgrade by a new ADR if matching-simulator R6 evidence lapses or the window-hosted composition cannot build for two reviews.

modules.name: wzzc-dev/moui

modules.graduation: Already public; retain only while it remains in an approved release stage and its required API and test gates pass.
modules.retirement: Remove or merge if no composition root depends on the module for two reviews or its scope moves to a more cohesive owner.
